summary: Short kerb by a junction, steep, with homes 12 m away.
reasons: Houses 12 m away on same side
Starts right at a side-street mouth

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees screen the kerb; nearest dwellings are 12 m away on the same side, others 17 m and more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane, only 16 m of kerb and it begins at a junction mouth; room for one van at most.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the opposite side in imagery; none seen on this short kerb.

flags: Dwellings 12 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees on the east side; open to the road on the west.

best_section.where: East kerb of Taringa Parade, just south of the side-street junction, beside a tree-covered block
